findings.statement: load_current_candidate_identity rewrites repository-relative candidate manifest paths under the physical acceptance target, allowing execution-plans low-risk classification to hide real workflow-control-plane changes.

Repository governance and authority documents AGENTS.md, docs/adr/**, and docs/standards/** are currently classified as known low risk although the repair-completeness authority model treats them as authority or high-risk paths.
The current skill-route decision test mocks load_current_candidate_identity and does not prove the real candidate manifest producer-to-decision composition.
